summary: The change adds an https FX-rate integration, an inventory entry with owner and classification, and a read-only fx_rate helper. It does not alter any existing control-scoped symbol. The ticket, independent code review, security review and control-owner approval are all in place on the single head commit, and the head-commit CI run passes, including the exhaustive ENC-2 and INV-1 control tests. Two cosmetic issues do not violate any obligation: the inventory purpose text was copied from core-banking, and the PR description claims unit tests were updated although the diff adds none.
